lines.2: 「Hurry up and wake up. If you don't, I'll have to use force.」
lines.3: That's definitely what Otome would say.
lines.5: Then again, if that were enough to wake her, I wouldn't have a problem.
lines.6: 「Which means it's time to administer punishment.」
lines.7: 1. Tuck the elbows in lightly and take your stance.
lines.8: 2. Put your weight behind the fist, twisting as you swing through.
